description: Creates a semantic model from a complete authored model folder, preserving its expressions and partitions.
notes: --definition gathers a complete folder containing definition.pbism and its model body. --file accepts ONE model file, never repeated --file flags. Empty and native --one-lake-table creation need no definition files or --connection. Creation is LRO, not proof of query readiness: inspect/complete framing and verify a DAX query. Takeover and data purge are separate explicitly reviewed operations, not automatic creation steps. See context best-practices bi-creation.
